title: Hearty Smoky Italian White Yam Panettone
description: A smoky and comforting Italian dish featuring white yam, robata-grilled to perfection and formed into a panettone shape, perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the cubed white yams with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Grill the white yams for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the grilled white yams, grana padano cheese, and chopped parsley.
Mix the ingredients together until they are well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a panettone mold and shape it into a panettone form.
Let the mixture cool and set for at least 30 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice the panettone into thick slices and serve warm.
Garnish with additional parsley and grana padano cheese if desired.
